product_launches.description: Factory launched Droids, agent-native software development agents that integrate with developers’ existing tools and workflows after topping the Terminal Bench benchmark.

overview_description.description: Factory functions within integrated development environments, command line interfaces, and continuous integration pipelines. The technology allows for the delegation of technical tasks, including code refactors, system migrations, and incident responses. These digital agents also perform automated code reviews and facilitate the maintenance of builds during the development process. Integration extends to communication platforms and project management software, allowing users to trigger actions from various interfaces. The system supports the parallelization of agents to manage software updates and maintenance across multiple operating systems.
